verdict.rationale: Retell stores call transcripts and recordings, and it offers programmatic access through SDKs with 'full voice and chat endpoint coverage' and through call_ended and call_analyzed webhooks delivered to your server. However, no evidence explicitly shows an API or webhook payload that returns the recording file or full transcript for each call. missing for 10: a documented get-call or list-calls endpoint returning recording URLs and transcripts, confirmation that webhook payloads include transcript and recording data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call

citations.quote: call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events delivered to your server so you can react to call activity without polling
Typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage.
automatically delete call and chat data — transcripts, recordings, and logs — after a set period for compliance
